dedupe_keys.name: effects of tram warning application on automated shuttle bus and tram interaction

description: The source describes a simulation study of an automated shuttle sharing a tram lane in Hervanta, Tampere, under differing traffic conditions. It explicitly distinguishes this modelled study from an earlier physical testbed, whose reported 24-to-39-second tram travel-time change and obstruction frequencies are cited background. Those figures are not claimed as outcomes of this simulation. The native source links the work to a 2024 Helsinki thesis; detailed simulation inputs and independently released executable remain unknown. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
name: Effects of Tram Warning Application on Automated Shuttle Bus and Tram Interaction
notes: Native publication date is not a verified observation interval. Project membership alone does not establish resource inclusion. Listed unverified routes timed out in zero-body landing checks; exact native metadata was retrieved successfully. Underlying files remain unchecked.
